summary.name: Panel: Educating SRE
summary.one_liner: A 2015 SREcon15 USENIX panel discussion on how to train new SREs, keep company SREs up to date, and educate developers on SRE best practices.
use_cases: Learning how companies train new SREs coming from university
Finding ideas for running internal SRE training programs
Getting guidance on educating developers about metrics, caching and deployment
Reading perspectives from large and small companies on SRE education
Researching SRE team culture and knowledge sharing
summary.what_it_does: This is a conference panel page from SREcon15 (USENIX, Santa Clara, March 2015), not a software tool. The panel covers three areas: educating new SREs coming out of higher education, keeping SREs current on company-specific tools and processes, and educating developers on best practices such as emitting metrics and adding caching. Panelists are Craig Sebenik (Matterport), David Mah (Dropbox), Andrew Widdowson (Google, tech lead for the internal "SRE EDU" effort) and Philip Boyle (Facebook). The page includes panelist bios but no slides, transcript or recording details.
notable: Panel includes engineers from Google, Dropbox, Matterport and Facebook
Covers both large-company and single-SRE startup perspectives
Part of the USENIX SREcon15 conference program
caveats: Describes a conference session, not a downloadable tool or product
Page does not include slides, recording or transcript details
